name_input: SUDEEP PHARMA LIMITED; SUDEEP PHARMA LIMITED
export_evidence: ImportKey India customs page (https://importkey.com/countries/india/sudeep-pharma-limited) — counter: "Total Shipments 1812 Records detected", "Trading Partners 51", "Latest Cargo 2026-02-28"; rows actually seen on the free view: 5 shipment rows. Exact evidence line: "2026-02-28 | SUDEEP PHARMA LIMITED TO THE ORDER | Calcium Carbonate (Coral) USP Powder- | HAZIRA PORT SURAT INHZA1, India | Chittagong, Bangladesh | 28365000 | BOL 1124413". Other rows seen: 2026-02-27 Mundra Sea -> Atlanta, UNITED STATES, HS 29152990, BOL 1071303 (Sodium Acetate anhydrous FCC powder); 2026-02-26 Mundra Sea -> New York, UNITED STATES, HS 29224990, BOL 1029155 (Magnesium Glycinate); 2026-02-25 Hazira Port Surat -> Port Said, EGYPT, HS 28365000, BOL 7731739 (Calcium Carbonate ACMA 35, buyer ACMA FOR CHEMICALS AND MINING); 2026-02-24 Ahmedabad Air -> JEDDAH, SAUDI ARABIA, HS 28352500, BOL 9951662 (Dibasic Calcium Phosphate Dihydrate USP). Top ports listed: HAZIRA PORT SURAT 110, HAZIRA PORT SURAT INHZA1 86, ICD VARNAMA INVRM6 60, AHEMDABAD AIR ACC INAMD4 56, HAZIRA PORT SURAT ICD 52.
note: Export side is factually confirmed by dated customs/B-L records with destination, HS code and BOL number — not a website claim. Declared HS 130219 (vegetable saps/extracts) does not match the observed shipment HS codes (28365000 calcium carbonate, 29152990 acetate, 29224990 glycinate, 28352500 dicalcium phosphate); per project rules this is NOT a rejection ground — the company stays in the base and the actual HS should be corrected to the observed inorganic-salt/mineral lines (verdict would be accepted_hs_corrected). Domestic supply evidence could not be verified: web_search backend was down (searx connection refused) for all queries, and registry/financial aggregators (ZaubaCorp, Tofler, TheCompanyCheck, Volza, Eximpedia) returned 403/404. No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender or annual-report domestic split was obtained, so domestic_status is unknown with null evidence rather than inferred. Revenue and export volume figures are not public on the free views and are left null — not estimated. Note the ImportKey page mixes several related entities (SUDEEP PHARMA LIMITED, SUDEEP PHARMA PRIVATE LIMITED, SUDEEP NUTRITION PRIVATE LIMITED) and some rows are imports into India (e.g. ACMA FOR CHEMICALS AND MINING -> SUDEEP PHARMA LIMITED, Port Said -> Hazira, BOL 7731739), so the 1812 counter is not a pure export count; the five rows quoted above are the export-direction records actually seen.
